name: campusos
description: CampusOS — a unified community and administration platform for university campuses.
author: Chatush Raj

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
